purpose: Reusable logical-pixel grammar derived from representative vanilla shirts; no source tile is copied into generated output.

grammarRules.shoulders: Keep the front neckline gap centered; carry a dark shoulder cap into both sides and simplify it to a short top cluster in side view.
grammarRules.torso: Use one connected dominant garment field. Interior base clusters should be larger than highlight, accent, or seam clusters.
grammarRules.neckline: Spend the top two or three rows on one readable neckline/collar landmark; do not stack unrelated neck details.
grammarRules.outerEdge: Prefer shadow or deepest shade on lower outer edges; use light only as a short upper-facing shoulder cluster.
grammarRules.underCollar: Place a shadow boundary directly below a collar or yoke so the feature reads as construction rather than noise.
grammarRules.centerOpening: Use one continuous center seam/opening. Buttons are sparse points attached to that line, never scattered.
grammarRules.sideCompression: Retain palette, collar, hem, and front-edge logic while removing front-only motifs. Do not redraw a second independent design.
grammarRules.backSimplification: Remove front closures and chest accents, but retain the back collar/yoke, hem, and broad material shading.
grammarRules.highlights: Use contiguous clusters near upper shoulders or a panel edge; avoid single-pixel specular noise.
grammarRules.accents: Use one declared landmark and keep it subordinate to silhouette and garment structure.
grammarRules.dyeMask: Encode only the main fabric ramp in grayscale. Keep secondary fabric and accent colors in the protected base half.
grammarRules.directionalGeneration: Build front, back, and one side from the same recipe, then mirror the structural side view for the opposite direction unless a declared physical feature needs a visibility rule.

fitInterpretation.fitted: Narrow only the lowest row and tighten lower-edge shading; vanilla's fixed 8x8 anchor leaves little safe silhouette freedom.
fitInterpretation.regular: Use the recurring vanilla coverage and balanced edge shading.
fitInterpretation.relaxed: Keep regular coverage but broaden lower shadow/hem clusters; fit is communicated primarily through value mass rather than extra canvas width.
